course_description: Study of fundamental data structures, recursive algorithms, dynamic memory, sorting, trees, and algorithmic complexity.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement fundamental data structures using dynamic memory management techniques for specific application requirements.
Analyze the time and space complexity of sorting algorithms to determine efficiency in varying input scenarios.
Design efficient tree-based data structures for hierarchical storage systems and network routing applications.
Evaluate recursive algorithm performance against iterative approaches based on computational cost metrics.
Synthesize complex problem solutions using integrated data structures and algorithms for system development.
